summary.membership_digest_format: Ordinal-sorted repo-relative paths; path|size|LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks; UTF-8 without BOM or final newline

checks.overlap_algorithm: Case-insensitive entry and ancestor-prefix HashSets, linear in total reviewed path components; no quadratic cross-entry scan.

safety_scope: Validator reads exact reviewed manifests and paths only, never grants approval or changes artifact files.
Read-only Git uses --no-optional-locks and core.longpaths=true; all currently tracked members rejected.
Parent traversal, wildcard/absolute paths, Git metadata, broad source/AgentRead targets, source/document/config members and reparse ancestors/children rejected.
Config ancestors are allowed only for an exact __pycache__ directory or direct .pyc member, with all selected files required to be .pyc.
Directory membership is checked by count, bytes and exact path/size/mtime digest before returning any validated file list.
Recheck runs a fresh full pass and requires unchanged manifest and validator bytes.
Metadata verification is not an OS-level filesystem lock. Require quiescent artifact writers and an immediate recheck before any future separately authorized execution.
notes: This evidence records metadata, text/JSON parsing and file hashing only. No Isaac, CUDA, learner, checkpoint load/save, archive extraction or deletion was run.
